items:
Home Highlights
- Private Resort-Style Pool (Pool can be heated for an additional $60 per day between Oct 1 - May 1)
- Elevator
- 6 Seater Golf Cart Included
- 6 Adult Bicycles Included
- New Construction
- Short Walk to the Beach
- Game Room

Welcome to Endless Summer, a modern coastal retreat designed for relaxed gathering and elevated 30A living. This newly constructed, four-level home offers generous space and thoughtful design, making it ideal for large groups, extended families, or friends traveling together.
The home features seven bedrooms, including a private in-law suite, along with multiple living areas that allow everyone to spread out and unwind. Beverage stations on every floor keep entertaining easy, while the chef-forward kitchen is perfect for shared meals and casual hosting. A gas fireplace anchors the main living space, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere.
Outdoor living is woven throughout, with covered balconies for quiet moments and a top-floor entertainment space and sundeck complete with a fire pit, perfect for evenings under the stars with coastal breezes and the sound of nearby waves.
When you’re ready to take a break from the beach, relax by the private resort-style pool. A game room adds extra fun, while a private elevator provides easy access to all levels.
Just a short walk to the beach, Endless Summer also includes a six-seater golf cart and six adult bicycles, making it easy to explore 30A at your own pace. Thoughtfully designed and effortlessly inviting, Endless Summer is the perfect home base for an elevated coastal escape.

Sleeping Arrangements

- King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower/Tub Combo
- Queen Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower/Tub Combo
- Twin over Twin Bunkroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only

Second Floor
- Two Queen over Queen Bunkroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only
- King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only
- Half Bathroom

Third Floor
- King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only
- Master King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower/Tub Separate

Fourth Floor

Emerald Coast Mirror Maze and SkyWheel are also worth visiting.
